summary: Publishing a post emails the rendered article body once, stored in an immutable campaign snapshot.
detailed_changes: Campaign snapshots now store Editor.js HTML from BlockRenderer at send time, and the email template renders that body.
A live campaign remains one per post (idempotency key post:{id}:live), so later edits do not resend or rewrite the emailed body.
affected_areas: Page or route: staff publish with email_on_publish
User groups affected: confirmed mailing subscribers
Public impact: publish emails include the article body, not only the excerpt
Internal impact: consent, unsubscribe, and one-send-per-publish rules are unchanged
